# Builder's Knowledge Garden — Agent (MCP) Interface

> Read-only, interpreted, cited construction knowledge for AI agents. California-first.

## What this garden knows
Building codes, permitting, jurisdictional requirements, materials, methods, and safety —
organised as structured, version-tracked entities across 44 jurisdictions. Every answer is
interpreted from those entities and cited to its code section + source. Coverage is honest:
out-of-corpus jurisdictions return "not yet covered" rather than a guess.

## MCP endpoint
- URL: https://builders.theknowledgegardens.com/api/mcp/bkg
- Transport: Streamable HTTP (Model Context Protocol)
- Methods: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, ping
- GET the URL for the live tool catalogue, JSON schemas, and connection snippet.

## Connect
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http bkg https://builders.theknowledgegardens.com/api/mcp/bkg`
- JSON: { "mcpServers": { "bkg": { "type": "http", "url": "https://builders.theknowledgegardens.com/api/mcp/bkg" } } }

## Tools
- lookup_jurisdiction_requirements(jurisdiction, topic?, discipline?, limit?)
  → cited code requirements for a topic in a place.
- permit_checklist_for_scope(jurisdiction, scope)
  → interpreted permit/compliance checklist grounded in governing code sections.
- citation_for_claim(claim, jurisdiction?)
  → corroborating code sections + a verdict tier (authoritative / corroborated / single / uncovered).

## Answer shape
Each tools/call returns a text block plus structuredContent:
`{ answer, verdict, citations[], coverage{covered,reason}, disclaimer, meta }`.
Citations carry: label, source, url, jurisdiction, verification level.

## Access & pricing
- Eval (free): no key; rate-limited per IP. Send no Authorization header.
- Metered: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key: <key>`; higher limits; billable per query.
- Directory: https://builders.theknowledgegardens.com/api/gardens

## Use responsibly
Interpreted from structured data and cited to source — not legal or engineering advice.
Verify against the authority having jurisdiction before relying on it.
